verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes supports concurrent/parallel operations via a multiplexed connection that 'avoids subrequest limits when making many concurrent operations' (docs-17) and allows multiple isolated sessions per sandbox for parallel workflows (docs-9, docs-18, docs-39), plus getSandbox() to manage many sandbox instances by ID. However there's no documented batch/bulk API primitive for iterating over large item sets, and community feedback flags unclear resource limits and high per-vCPU pricing that would constrain large-scale bulk workloads (comm-3, comm-6, comm-11). Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation API or example, documented concurrency/resource ceilings, and independent evidence of successful large-scale parallel execution.
